intended_values: Simple Young modules with nonprojective polynomial injective hulls; Alec Kriebel; version 1.0; preprint date 2026-10-16; problem 30001223; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/786. For every odd prime p over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p at q=1, r=2p-1 and lambda=(2p-2,1), the source-convention Young module is simple of dimension2p-2 but I_n(lambda) is nonprojective for EVERY n>=2. This completely refutes both broad proposed bridges in Miyachi's printed2009 Conjecture7; the stronger index-set proposal is not an assumed established equivalence. The separate DeVisscher-Donkin classification, characteristic-zero nontrivial-root variants and p2 are outside the result. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof verification. Historical priority remains UNRESOLVED. Natural Young/augmentation structure, local GL2 facts and DD/Cox-Parker/Erdmann-Law structural inputs are classical and credited. Extensive bounded primary-source audits verified no complete predecessor in inspected statements; unread EH2002a/b, Fang2014, Fang-JunHu2025online/2026issue, older tables/books and citation/version gaps remain material. No firstness, certified novelty or current worldwide-open-status claim. Deposit includes PDF and source/verification archive.
